newsitem.title: USA: CME November lumber futures end up $10 limit.
newsitem.headline: CME November lumber futures end up $10 limit.

text.p: CME November lumber futures posted limit gains of $10 per tbf and January was up $9.40 in reaction to talk of higher cash lumber prices, traders said.
Cash-connected buying was noted throughout the session, which traders said appeared to be lumber dealers hedging futures purchases.
In addition to continued strong demand for cash lumber, analysts said there were concerns sales from Canada may slow as some mills there may have met export quotas.
Lumber closed up $10.00 to $2.00 with November up the $10.00 limit at $405.00 and January was up $9.40 at $396.70.
